item.description:
Fixed

  • Heat protection no longer says "Paused for heat" one percent under the limit, where it was asking macOS for nothing and charging went on.
  • Lowering the limit during a heat pause can no longer leave macOS holding a level above the new limit.
  • The Remove Helper dialog now says where your limit goes for every limit macOS does not offer by itself.
  • A new limit no longer waits up to ten seconds behind an earlier one that macOS has not reported yet.
  • A calibration's two-hour rest no longer counts a sleep that began with the charger off.
  • Restarting after the helper is allowed puts your limit back before the new copy starts.

Every version's changes

Fixed

  • Heat protection acts sooner. It pauses charging once the battery has been above the threshold for one minute, not three. macOS still takes a minute or two to stop charging after that.
  • Reopening Hachibu no longer starts that wait again. The time the battery was already hot is read from what History recorded, so a restart or an update while the battery is hot does not delay the pause.

Every version's changes

New

  • See charging at a glance. The right end of the battery in the menu bar icon changes with the power source: the plain terminal on battery, two plug pins when the charger is connected but the battery is not charging, and a bolt while charging.

Every version's changes
